methodology: Authoritative validation matches archived NadiTwin forecasts to gauge OBSERVED discharge at the same station within ±45 min of valid time. NadiTwin hydrograph series is MODELLED and used only as a non-authoritative proxy. Invalid P10>P90 snapshots rejected. Metrics withheld unless n ≥ 8 gauge pairs.
disclaimer: Do not treat forecast availability as forecast verification. No fabricated accuracy. NSE reported only when variance of observations is positive.
note: Authoritative metrics require gauge OBSERVED pairs ≥ 8. NadiTwin hydrograph is MODELLED proxy only.
